name: RansomHub: Domain & user enumeration via net.exe
description: net.exe enumerating Domain Admins / Enterprise Admins or running with /domain. Mirrors The DFIR Report RansomHub 2025-06 first-hour recon (rh-01-recon-domain).
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "1" and process.name : "net.exe" and process.args : ("Domain Admins" or "Enterprise Admins" or "/domain")
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: Internal network sweep (PowerShell + many TCP connects)
description: PowerShell making more than 30 distinct outbound TCP connections within five minutes — substitute for Advanced IP Scanner / SoftPerfect NetScan (rh-02-recon-network).
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "3" and process.name : "powershell.exe" and destination.port : (135 or 139 or 445 or 3389 or 5985)
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: LSASS process access (credential dumping)
description: Sysmon Event 10 reading lsass.exe memory with GrantedAccess flags consistent with MiniDump (0x1010, 0x1410, 0x1438, 0x143a). Catches the comsvcs.dll LSASS dump used in rh-03-creds-lsass and the mimikatz pattern from the original report.
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "10" and winlog.event_data.TargetImage : *lsass.exe and winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess : (*0x1010* or *0x1038* or *0x1410* or *0x1438* or *0x143a* or *0x1fffff*) and not winlog.event_data.SourceImage : (*\\MsMpEng.exe or *\\svchost.exe or *\\wininit.exe)
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM hive saved via reg.exe
description: reg.exe save of HKLM\SAM, HKLM\SECURITY, or HKLM\SYSTEM — offline credential extraction (rh-04-creds-sam).
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "1" and process.name : "reg.exe" and process.command_line : (*save*HKLM\\SAM* or *save*HKLM\\SECURITY* or *save*HKLM\\SYSTEM*)
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: Finance share enumeration
description: net.exe / PowerShell enumeration of \\win-server\Finance — picks up rh-05-disc-fileshare's discovery walk before exfil staging.
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "1" and (process.command_line : *\\\\win-server\\Finance* or (process.name : "net.exe" and process.command_line : (*view*\\\\win-server* or *use*Finance*)))
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: fsutil SymlinkEvaluation toggled
description: fsutil behavior set SymlinkEvaluation R2L:1 / R2R:1 — the actor's distinctive defense-evasion trick before symlink-walking shares (rh-06-evasion-symlink).
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "1" and process.name : "fsutil.exe" and process.command_line : *SymlinkEvaluation*
author: Hunt Lab

subtechnique.name: Windows File and Directory Permissions Modification

name: RansomHub: rclone.exe staged from downloads.rclone.org
description: DNS lookup for downloads.rclone.org or rclone.exe written to C:\Users\Public — runtime tool staging (rh-07-tool-rclone-dl).
query: (event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "22" and dns.question.name : *rclone.org*) or (event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "11" and file.path : *\\Users\\Public\\rclone.exe)
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: rclone exfil wrapper artifacts staged
description: nocmd.vbs, rcl.bat, or include.txt written to C:\Users\Public — the exact filenames from The DFIR Report's exfil wrapper (rh-08-tool-stage-artifacts).
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "11" and file.name : ("nocmd.vbs" or "rcl.bat" or "include.txt") and file.path : *\\Users\\Public\\*
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: wscript → cmd → rclone exfil chain
description: Process tree wscript.exe → cmd.exe → rclone.exe — the canonical RansomHub exfil wrapper (nocmd.vbs spawning rcl.bat spawning rclone) (rh-09-exfil-rclone).
query:
sequence by host.name with maxspan=2m
  [process where event.code == "1" and process.name == "wscript.exe" and process.command_line like "*nocmd.vbs*"]
  [process where event.code == "1" and process.name == "rclone.exe" and process.parent.name == "cmd.exe"]
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: Volume shadow copies deleted
description: vssadmin.exe or wmic.exe deleting shadow copies — pre-impact ransomware preparation (rh-10-impact-vss).
query: event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "1" and ((process.name : "vssadmin.exe" and process.command_line : (*Delete*Shadows* or *delete*shadows*)) or (process.name : "wmic.exe" and process.command_line : *shadowcopy*delete*))
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: README_RANSOMHUB.txt dropped
description: README_RANSOMHUB.txt file create — ransom note from the simulated impact stage (rh-11-impact-encrypt). In a real intrusion, multiple drops in quick succession across user folders is a strong impact signal.
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: Windows event logs cleared
description: wevtutil cl on Application/System/Security or Security event 1102 (audit log cleared) — the actor's parting gift (rh-12-evasion-clearlogs).
query: (event.dataset : "windows.sysmon_operational" and event.code : "1" and process.name : "wevtutil.exe" and process.command_line : *cl*) or (event.dataset : "system.security" and event.code : "1102")
author: Hunt Lab

name: RansomHub: S3 PutObject burst (cloud exfil)
description: More than 25 S3 PutObject events from a single principal within five minutes. Catches rh-09's rclone exfil to s3://ransomhub-exfil-lab on LocalStack via the cloudtrail-gen tailer.
author: Hunt Lab
